name: fl_bin_inspect
description: Fast native binary layout and security mitigations triage for ELF, PE, and Mach-O binaries. Inspects architecture, headers, segments, dynamic symbols, dependencies, and security mitigations (NX/DEP, Stack Canary, PIE/ASLR, RELRO).
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

binary_path.description: Path to the binary file (ELF, PE, or Mach-O) to inspect.

inspection_type.description: Scope of inspection: 'all' (headers, mitigations, sections, dependencies), 'mitigations' (NX, PIE, Canary, RELRO only), 'symbols' (exported/imported symbols). Defaults to 'all'.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
